165|10:57|ההוא בא לעשות ככה עם החרב, טאק נפל לו על הזקן, חתך לו את הזקן.|That one went to do like this with the sword, whack, it fell on his beard and cut off his beard.|Aquele foi fazer assim com a espada, zás, ela caiu na barba dele e cortou a barba.

168|11:14|עכשיו לא התגלחתי כי רציתי להתגלח, התגלחתי כי המכונה של הגילוח עשתה|Now, I didn't shave because I wanted to shave. I shaved because the shaving machine made|Agora, eu não me barbeei porque quis me barbear. Me barbeei porque a máquina de barbear deu

Know that this is how it was, it was beyond|Então primeiro pedi a ele perdão e desculpas, Rabino, por ter me barbeado. Saiba que foi assim, foi por motivo de

175|11:39|אמר לי, זה בסדר, הרב מאיר, זה בסדר, גם לי היה פעם משהו כזה.|He said to me, it's all right, Rav Meir, it's all right, something like that happened to me once too.|Ele me disse: está tudo bem, Rav Meir, está tudo bem, uma vez aconteceu algo assim comigo também.
176|11:43|אמרתי לו, גם לך נתפסה מכונת גילוח?|I said to him, a shaving machine got stuck on you too?|Eu disse a ele: a máquina de barbear também prendeu em você?
177|11:46|הוא אומר לי, לא, יותר גרוע.|He says to me, no, worse.|Ele me diz: não, pior.
178|11:48|אמרתי לו, מה?|I said to him, what?|Eu disse a ele: o quê?
179|11:49|הוא אומר, בבדיקת חמץ, אני בודק את החמץ עם הנר, פתאום אני רואה אש, להבות.|He says, during the search for chametz, I'm checking for chametz with the candle, suddenly I see fire, flames.|Ele diz: na busca do chametz, eu estou procurando o chametz com a vela, de repente vejo fogo, chamas.
180|11:54|כל הזקן שלו עלה בלהבות.|His whole beard went up in flames.|A barba dele inteira pegou fogo.
181|11:57|כמה צריך להיזהר בזה.|How careful one must be with this.|Como é preciso ter cuidado com isso.
182|11:59|היה לו זקן יפה, גדול, אומר לי, שנים עד שאירחתי אותו.|He had a beautiful, big beard, he tells me, years until I grew it back.|Ele tinha uma barba bonita, grande, ele me diz, foram anos até eu deixá-la crescer de novo.
183|12:03|הכל עלה בלהבות.|Everything went up in flames.|Tudo pegou fogo.
184|12:05|אז זה צריך להיזהר.|So one has to be careful.|Então é preciso ter cuidado.

190|12:21|משה, תעשה אפקטים, משה.|Moshe, do the effects, Moshe.|Moshe, faça os efeitos, Moshe.
191|12:23|איך היה עוד פעם?|How was it again?|Como foi mesmo?
192|12:24|יופי, רק את השטויות אתה אוהב.|Great, you only like the silly stuff.|Ótimo, você só gosta das bobagens.
193|12:27|אז זהו, ככה היה, גמרו את כל סיחון.|So that's it, that's how it was, they finished off all of Sichon.|Então é isso, foi assim, acabaram com todo o Sichon.
194|12:30|הלך סיחון הוא וכל עמו, זיכרונם לקללה.|Sichon went, he and all his people, may their memory be a curse.|Foi-se Sichon, ele e todo o seu povo, que a memória deles seja uma maldição.
195|12:34|עכשיו, אחרי זה, בא עוג הרשע.|Now, after that, Og the wicked came.|Agora, depois disso, veio Og, o perverso.
196|12:37|עכשיו אוג היה יותר רשם סיחון, היה גבוה, ענק.|Now Og was more wicked than Sichon; he was tall, a giant.|Agora, Og era mais perverso que Sichon; era alto, um gigante.
197|12:41|ואוג זה הפליט אצל אברהם אבינו, שהוא אברהם מל אותו.|And this Og was the refugee who came to Avraham Avinu, whom Avraham circumcised.|E esse Og era o sobrevivente que veio a Avraham Avinu, que Avraham circuncidou.
198|12:45|זה מה שכתוב כאן בסוף הפרשה של שבוע שעבר.|That is what is written here at the end of last week's Parashah.|Isso é o que está escrito aqui no final da Parashá da semana passada.
199|12:48|אל תירא אותו, כי בידך נתתי אותו ואת כל עמו ועשיתם לו כאשר עשיתם לסיחון מלך האמור.|"Do not fear him, for I have given him into your hand, and all his people; and you shall do to him as you did to Sichon, king of the Amorites."|"Não o temas, pois eu o entreguei na tua mão, ele e todo o seu povo; e farás a ele como fizeste a Sichon, rei dos amorreus."
